title: Injective module sheaves are injective as module presheaves
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be the abelian category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be the category of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules with sheafification left adjoint to the inclusion [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. If $I$ is injective in $\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], then the underlying presheaf of $I$ is injective in $\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$.
